name: u5pwcharge2
prompt: A colossal surge of raw electric power released all at once: an enormous crackling discharge of lightning and energy with a deep powerful electric hum, then one long slow decay, the crackles thinning and the hum sinking lower and fading gradually over the whole nine and a half seconds, never stopping early. No voices, no singing, no choir, no humming voice, no chanting, no bells, no chimes, no gongs, no music.
where: R173: the charge up the shaft to the strike (made: turned back to front)
